_about: External data-source lineage for PILAR-2b / CP2B Maps. Records each upstream dataset, its version/reference year, access URL, and (where known) DOI, so the platform's outputs are traceable and reproducible. Required for academic submission (CEUS).
_status_notes: VERIFY items below must be confirmed before manuscript submission.

DISCREPANCY: MapBiomas collection — code references Collection 8.0 (backend/app/services/mapbiomas_service.py), while FOSS4G_PAPER_SUPPLEMENT.md states Collection 9. Reconcile and state ONE collection in the paper.

DISCREPANCY: IBGE agricultural reference year — master residue file is named *_SP_2023 (PAM 2023), while some docs cite Censo Agropecuario 2017 for livestock. Confirm the exact reference year per stream (crops vs livestock).
Retrieval dates ('retrieved') are placeholders pending confirmation from the data owner.

sources.name: IBGE — Producao Agricola Municipal (PAM) / SIDRA tabela 5457
sources.role: Crop production per municipality (sugarcane, citrus, corn, soybean, coffee)
sources.notes: Records green-cane and whole-fruit tonnage; residue fractions applied downstream (see Phase-1 correction).

sources.name: IBGE — Censo Agropecuario 2017
sources.role: Livestock herd counts (cattle, swine, poultry) -> manure tonnage via EMBRAPA factors

sources.name: MapBiomas — Land use / land cover
sources.role: Land-use classification for proximity analysis and feedstock siting context
sources.collection: 8.0 (code) — VERIFY vs Collection 9 cited in FOSS4G_PAPER_SUPPLEMENT.md
sources.doi: 10.58053/MapBiomas/JNJGVT (Collection 10 reference; confirm DOI for the collection actually used)
sources.notes: Forthcoming 2008-2024 LULC transition integration uses Collection 10 transition rasters (ABIOVE pipeline).

sources.name: SNIS — Sistema Nacional de Informacoes sobre Saneamento (2022)
sources.role: Urban MSW and sewage per-capita generation (FORSU, sludge)
sources.notes: ~88% municipal coverage for SP; gap-filled via per-capita factors.

sources.name: CONAB — Serie Historica de Graos / Cana
sources.role: Crop split (soy/corn 1st-2nd/cana) by UF and year

sources.name: UNICA / CONSECANA-SP
sources.role: Sugarcane residue fractions (bagaco 0.280, torta 0.030, vinhaca 0.420) and surplus assumptions

sources.name: FUNDECITRUS
sources.role: Citrus peel fraction (x0.50 of whole fruit)

sources.name: EPE — Balanco Energetico Nacional 2024
sources.role: FDE factor sourcing (FC/FCo/FS/FL) for several feedstocks (see FDE_TRACEABILITY_MATRIX.md)

sources.name: ANP — Dados Abertos, Biometano (capacity + monthly production)
sources.role: Real-world validation: authorized capacity and metered production per plant
sources.notes: Assembled; not yet ingested into validation_plants (P0).

sources.name: ANEEL — SIGA (Sistema de Informacoes de Geracao), empreendimentos em operacao
sources.role: Real-world validation: biomass/biogas generation plants (CEG code, capacity kW, fuel origin/source) -> validation_plants cross-check
sources.retrieved: VERIFY — fill in the day the snapshot is taken; the ingest lineage gate blocks promotion until then
sources.notes: Ingested via backend/ingest/sources/aneel_siga (the ingestion-contract template). MdaPotenciaOutorgadaKw is kW; the loader converts kW->MW exactly once. The 19.69 vs 6.39 discrepancy is a units-audit item — certify against ANEEL's published per-fuel totals via the aggregation gate on first real run.

sources.name: ANEEL — Geracao Distribuida (biogas units)
sources.notes: 546 units, 152 MW; electrical (kW) kept separate from biomethane (Nm3/d).

sources.name: FIESP / Instituto 17 + PSR + Amplun — 'O Biometano em Sao Paulo' (Jun 2025)
